newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Nepal tenders to buy kerosene, diesel for November.
newsitem.headline: Nepal tenders to buy kerosene, diesel for November.

text.p: State-owned Nepal Oil Corp (NOC) has issued a tender to buy superior kerosene and high speed diesel for November deliveries, traders said on Monday.
The tender seeks 30,000 tonnes of 1.0-percent sulphur diesel for November 5-11 delivery on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Paradeep or Haldia on India's east coast.
It also seeks 30,000 tonnes of kerosene for November 15-25 delivery on a c-and-f basis to Madras or Haldia.
The tender will close on October 12 and offers are valid for two days.

Nepal cancelled its previous tender to buy kerosene for October 1-15 delivery. The best offer on that tender was made by Kuwati-based International Petroleum Group (IPG) at $245 per tonne, c-and-f basis.
Nepal awarded its last diesel import tender for September 5-12 delivery to Ducth trader Vitol at $197.18 per tonne, c-and-f basis on a one-port discharge to Paradeep.
